item.title: 南韓三博企9月業績分化 百樂達斯賭收按年升38%濟州天城挫45%
item.description:
>
南韓三家主要外國人專用賭場營運商9月業績表現分化。 南韓三家主要外國人專用賭場營運商9月業績表現分化。其中百樂達斯(Paradise Co. Ltd.)博彩收入按年大增38.2%至867.26億韓圜(約5.06億港元)；GKL(Grand Korea Leisure Co. Ltd.)亦按年增長7.2%。不過樂天觀光開發(Lotte Tour Development Co. Ltd.)旗下濟州天城賭場收入按年大跌45.1%，按月亦減少37.7%。 百樂達斯9月博彩收入達867.26億韓圜，雖按月下跌16.8%，但按年則增長38.2%。其中賭枱收入為810.77億韓圜(約4.73億港元)，按月跌17.9%，按年大增40.4%；角子機收入為56.49億韓圜(約3,298萬港元)，按月增3.2%，按年亦升12.6%。 今年首9個月，百樂達斯累計博彩收入達7,445.88億韓圜(約43.48億港元)，按年增長10.8%；其中賭枱收入為6,972.86億韓圜(約40.72億港元)，按年升10.3%，角子機收入則為473.02億韓圜(約2.76億港元)，增長19%。 投注額方面，百樂達斯9月賭枱投注額為6,051.05億韓圜(約35.34億港元)，按月下跌11.1%，但按年增長6.6%；今年首9個月累計賭枱投注額達5兆7,717.37億韓圜(約337.07億港元)，按年增長8.1%。 百樂達斯公布的數據包括旗下首爾華克山莊、仁川百樂達斯城、釜山及濟州4間外國人專用賭場。 另一方面，GKL旗下賭場9月博彩收入為372.76億韓圜(約2.18億港元)，按月增長19.8%，按年亦升7.2%。其中賭枱收入達340.08億韓圜(約1.99億港元)，按月增長22.3%，按年升8.4%；角子機收入則為32.68億韓圜(約1,908.3萬港元)，按月及按年分別下跌1%及4.5%。 今年首9個月，GKL累計博彩收入為3,372.41億韓圜(約19.69億港元)，按年增長5.8%；其中賭枱收入為3,052.67億韓圜(約17.83億港元)，增長5.5%，角子機收入為319.74億韓圜(約1.87億港元)，按年升8.7%。 GKL上月博彩投注額為3,237.18億韓圜(約18.9億港元)，按月下跌5.2%，但按年增長2.4%；今年首9個月累計投注額達2兆9,742.6億韓圜(約173.7億港元)，按年增長9.5%。 GKL目前於首爾江南COEX、首爾龍山Dragon City及釜山樂天酒店經營3間「七樂」(Seven Luck)品牌外國人專用賭場。 營運濟州天城綜合度假村的樂天觀光開發公佈，9月賭場淨收入為290.86億韓圜(約1.7億港元)，按月大跌37.7%，按年亦減45.1%。其中賭枱收入為257.78億韓圜(約1.51億港元)，按月跌41.3%，按年大跌49.6%；角子機收入則為33.08億韓圜(約1,932萬港元)，按月增長21.3%，按年大增80.6%。 截至9月底，今年累計賭場淨收入達3,930.83億韓圜(約22.95億港元)，按年增長17.7%。其中賭枱收入為3,723.95億韓圜(約21.75億港元)，按年增長16.9%；角子機收入為206.88億韓圜(約1.21億港元)，按年大增34.1%。 樂天觀光開發表示，公司披露的賭場收入按照國際財務報告準則(IFRS)，從博彩毛收入(GGR)扣除支付予中介人的佣金等項目後計算。南韓賭場協會統計的濟州天城9月博彩收入則為375.96億韓圜(約2.2億港元)，較公司披露的淨收入高85.1億韓圜(約4,970萬港元)。 投注額方面，濟州天城賭場9月總投注額為2,761.15億韓圜(約16.12億港元)，按月跌17.9%，按年減5.8%。其中賭枱投注額為2,378.24億韓圜(約13.89億港元)，按月跌19%，按年減10.5%；角子機投注額為382.91億韓圜(約2.24億港元)，按月跌10.1%，但按年增長39.4%。 今年首9個月，濟州天城總投注額約2兆2,871.18億韓圜(約133.6億港元)，其中賭枱投注額約1兆9,597.41億韓圜(約114.48億港元)、角子機投注額約3,273.77億韓圜(約19.12億港元)。 持有率方面，9月賭枱持有率由8月的15.95%進一步降至10.84%，亦低於去年同期的19.23%；角子機持有率則由6.40%升至8.64%，高於去年同期的6.67%。 儘管博彩收入及投注額下跌，9月賭場訪客數反而增至66,393人，按月增長12.4%，按年亦增長12.4%。這亦顯示，濟州天城9月博彩收入大幅下跌，主要與賭枱投注額減少及持有率顯著下降有關；今年累計賭場訪客達521,572人次，按年升21%。 酒店業務方面，濟州天城9月酒店收入為63.31億韓圜(約3,698.1萬港元)，按月下跌27.9%，按年減少8.7%；今年首9個月累計酒店收入則達648.24億韓圜(約3.79億港元)，按年增長9.6%。公司另指，按獨立財務報表口徑計算，9月酒店收入為142.67億韓圜(約8,334.2萬港元)。

item.title: 司警首破踢角子機製造故障呃退款 內地男六度犯案移送檢察院
item.description:
>
司警首破腳踢角子機製造故障詐賭案。 澳門司法警察局首次揭發有人以人為損壞機器方式製造故障進行詐賭。一名52歲吳姓內地男子，涉嫌在娛樂場投注失利時，以腳踢「骰寶」角子機機艙觸發系統故障，藉此退回已輸注碼，導致娛樂場損失至少1.3萬港元。 司警表示，涉案娛樂場於本月7日下午通報有人以欺詐方式賭博，保安員現場截獲吳姓疑人並移交司警調查。據監控畫面顯示，吳姓疑人於前晚約8時半，在近1小時內至少6次於投注不利時，踢向機器下方機艙，使角子機觸發故障閃燈及投注作廢訊號，讓系統自動將已輸金額退回賭博餘額。 司警於疑人身上檢獲3,500港元懷疑不法所得，具體涉案金額仍待進一步釐清。由於有強烈迹象顯示吳姓男子涉嫌觸犯欺詐性賭博罪，司警已依法將其移送檢察院偵辦。

item.title: 南韓江原樂園賭場常客逾半滿60歲 長者到訪人次3年增三成六
item.description:
>
江原樂園賭場常客逾半屬六旬以上長者。(韓國觀光公社圖片) 南韓唯一容許本地居民入場的賭場江原樂園(Kangwon Land)，在頻繁到訪的賭客中，長者比例明顯偏高。今年到訪賭場至少30天的常客中，超過一半為60歲以上人士，相關年齡層的到訪人次近年亦持續上升。 南韓國會議員車圭根近日公佈江原樂園提交的資料顯示，今年1月1日至9月15日期間，江原樂園共有349,289名不重複訪客，其中87,533人為60歲以上，佔整體25.1%。不過，期內共有12,586人到訪至少30天，其中6,304人為60歲以上，佔50.1%，即平均每兩名常客便有一人屬60歲以上。 江原樂園坐落於南韓高原地區一處廢棄礦區，距離首爾約3小時車程。Allin此前在江原樂園採訪時亦獲確認，賭客以50歲以上人士為主，年輕賭客相對少見。 據車圭根公佈的資料，期內到訪至少60天的2,437名客戶中，60歲以上人士亦有1,172人，佔48.1%；若按不同年齡層比較，60歲以上訪客中有7.2%今年曾到訪至少30天，而60歲以下訪客的相關比例只有2.4%，意味長者成為頻繁訪客的比例是較年輕客戶的3倍。 數據亦顯示，江原樂園的長者到訪人次近年持續增加。若將同一名客戶每次到訪均分別計算，60歲以上人士的總到訪人次由2022年的711,659人次，增至2025年的972,440人次，三年間增長36.6%；60歲以上人士佔整體到訪人次的比例亦逐年上升，由2022年的34.2%，增至2023年的34.7%、2024年的37.4%及2025年的39.2%。 期內60歲以上人士到訪達718,568人次，佔江原樂園整體到訪人次41.5%，進一步升至逾四成水平。 車圭根表示，與一般訪客相比，長期及頻繁到訪賭場的客戶中，長者所佔比例明顯較高，而且仍呈快速上升趨勢。他認為，江原樂園應將保障年長客戶置於賭場收益之上，盡快加強針對不同年齡及到訪頻率的博彩危害預防措施，包括檢視頻繁到訪情況，以及為相關客戶提供專業輔導服務。

item.title: Judiciary Police Receive Reports of Fake Douyin Customer Service Scams Involving Over MOP 2.3 Million
item.description:
>
Judiciary Police Receive Reports of Fake Douyin Customer Service Scams Involving Over MOP 2.3 Million Scams impersonating customer service assistants of Douyin (the Chinese mainland version of TikTok) have resurfaced in Macau. The Judiciary Police have recently received three related cases, involving a total loss of over MOP 2.3 million. The largest single loss exceeded MOP 2 million, and no arrests have been made thus far.   The cases involve three local victims (two males and one female), ranging from middle-aged to elderly individuals. The incidents occurred on the afternoon and evening of October 5. The scammers called the victims, claiming to be Douyin staff members, and falsely alleged that the victims had activated a Douyin live-streaming membership for which an MOP 800 service fee would be charged. They offered to assist in canceling the fee.   The scammers then provided a purported IP address, contacted the victims via WhatsApp, and further guided them to enable the screen-sharing function on their mobile phones. Under the pretext of checking account statements and investigating virtual transactions, the scammers lured the victims into logging into their mobile banking and electronic payment accounts, and handing over credit card information.   The three victims subsequently received bank transfer notification SMS messages and found out that their account deposits had been completely drained. They then discovered they had been scammed and reported the cases to the police for assistance. The Judiciary Police are currently following up and investigating the cases.   Regarding this scam, Allin subsequently received a tip-off from a reader who recounted a personal experience of receiving a “Douyin customer service” scam call. The reader stated that he had received a call from a man speaking Cantonese with an accent. The caller accurately stated the reader’s surname, and claimied that a Douyin live-streaming service had been activated and that an MOP 800 membership fee needed to be collected. Fortunately, the reader was sharp-witted, instantly exposing the caller as a fraudster and threatening to call the police, causing the scammer to hang up.   In addition, the reader reported that he was being constantly plagued by various nuisance calls recently, revealing that starting the day after activating a Hong Kong phone number service (One Number, Multi-SIM) through a certain telecommunications company, they began continuously receiving promotional calls from various insurance companies, banks, and medical institutions in Hong Kong.

item.title: Grand Korea Leisure Q3 Operating Profit Expected to Drop 11.3%
item.description:
>
Grand Korea Leisure Q3 Operating Profit Expected to Drop 11.3% Grand Korea Leisure Co Ltd (GKL), a South Korean foreigner-only casino operator, is expected to post a third-quarter operating profit of KRW 15.4 billion (approx. US$11.5 million), representing a year-on-year decrease of 11.3%, according to a recent equity research report by KB Securities. The brokerage cited rising labor expenses as a key headwind squeezing the operator’s profitability margins.   In a report released on September 29, KB Securities noted that GKL’s Q3 gaming drop amount is expected to grow by 2.5% year-on-year, but the hold rate is projected to decline by 0.2 percentage points year-on-year, limiting revenue growth.   On the cost side, higher labor expenses will increase fixed costs, with GKL’s Q3 operating profit margin expected to fall from 15.8% in the same period last year to 14%.   10-Year Lease Renewal for COEX   Regarding GKL’s medium-to-long-term development, the brokerage firm noted that the company still needs further investment to secure long-term growth drivers. GKL previously announced that it had extended the lease for its Gangnam COEX casino in Seoul by 10 years, with the new term running from October 2026 to October 2035. KB pointed out that rental costs may rise following the renewal. Furthermore, as the COEX casino has been operating longer than other major casinos in South Korea, it has reached a stage requiring reinvestment and renovation, which may further push up future costs. The report noted that while GKL has maintained mid-single-digit annual revenue growth in recent years, market uncertainty regarding its medium-to-long-term growth prospects remains. The market had previously discussed the possibility of GKL constructing its own casino to seek new long-term growth drivers. However, KB believes that given the 10-year lease renewal for the COEX casino, the likelihood of implementing a self-built casino in the short term is low. KB’s operating profit forecasts for GKL for this year and next year are 12.2% and 14.3% lower than market consensus, respectively.   Impact of Tourism Promotion Development Fund Hike Expected to Be Limited   On the other hand, the South Korean gaming industry has recently focused on the government’s potential increase in the “Tourism Promotion Development Fund” levy, but KB believes the impact of such regulatory adjustments on GKL is limited. The report stated that because the revenue scale of GKL’s individual casinos is relatively modest, they are not expected to reach the threshold for higher levy rates; thus, even if the government raises fund levies on certain large-scale casinos, the direct impact on GKL will remain relatively limited. Overall, the brokerage firm considers GKL’s short-term earnings to be dragged down by the hold rate and labor costs, while post-renewal rent, renovation expenses for the COEX casino, and how the company identifies new medium-to-long-term growth drivers will serve as key factors for its future operations.   GKL Casino recorded gaming revenue of KRW 31.109 billion (approx. HK$181 million) in August, down 25.4% month-on-month and 11.3% year-on-year.

item.title: 永利臻典中國葡萄酒大賽11月全面啟動 明年3月開放報名
item.description:
>
2027永利臻典中國葡萄酒大賽11月全面啟動。 由永利度假村旗下高端生活方式品牌「Wynn Signature永利臻典」打造的「永利臻典 中國葡萄酒大賽」，將於今年11月9日發佈2027年賽程安排及推廣藍圖。賽事預計於明年3月1日開放報名，評審周於8月在北京舉行，年度頒獎典禮擬於10月底在澳門舉行。 本屆賽事迎來重大突破，評審周首度走出澳門、移師北京舉行。由全球專家組成的國際權威評審團齊聚首都，深入體驗在地風土與餐飲文化，推動中國佳釀走向世界。 大賽影響力獲國際高度認可，於今年8月榮獲亞太區權威公關獎項SABRE Awards Asia-Pacific品牌建設類別最高榮譽Diamond SABRE Award，成為該類別唯一獲獎者。 為持續推廣獲獎佳釀，永利已展開多元佈局，包括參與「食界精緻餐飲投資論壇」、推出深圳餐酒晚宴、協助策劃雲南德欽葡萄酒旅遊路線，並將參展寧夏「第47屆世界葡萄與葡萄酒大會」及「Tatler Best Awards Asia-Pacific 2026」，向全球展示中國葡萄酒的極致魅力。

item.title: 澳娛綜合舉行國慶酒會 何超鳳指集團續為澳門發展貢獻力量
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合舉行國慶77周年酒會。 澳娛綜合聯同澳娛綜合員工福利諮詢委員會(福諮會)及澳娛綜合勞資協商委員會，於今日(8日)在上葡京舉行「慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年國慶酒會」。常務董事何超鳳表示，澳娛綜合將繼續發揮自身優勢，融入國家發展大局，為澳門高質量發展貢獻力量。 澳娛綜合董事局主席霍震霆、常務董事何超鳳、勞資協商委員會顧問黃顯輝、董事兼福諮會主席梁安琪、董事霍啟山及秘書長官樂怡等，聯同逾2,000名員工歡聚一堂，共賀國慶，祝願祖國繁榮昌盛、澳門和諧穩定。 何超鳳致辭時表示，澳娛綜合植根澳門六十多年，背靠祖國、立足澳門，始終與祖國同心同行、與澳門共同成長。面對國家「十五五」規劃開局、澳門啟動「三五規劃」，以及大灣區和橫琴深合區加快建設所帶來的新機遇，澳娛綜合將繼續發揮自身優勢，圍繞綠色發展、琴澳融合和「旅遊+」創新三大方向，推動企業穩步向前。她指企業只有融入國家發展大局，才能成就自身更大前景。澳娛綜合將繼續把握時代脈搏、堅持守正創新，為澳門高質量發展貢獻力量。 梁安琪致辭時指，澳娛綜合一直堅持愛國愛澳、立足本土、回饋社會的初心；福諮會亦秉持何鴻燊博士「以人為本」的企業理念，用心關懷員工。她感謝澳娛綜合團隊的辛勤付出，並表示未來將與員工並肩共迎機遇、共創佳績。 作為澳門首家開展系統化愛國教育課程及紅色之旅的綜合旅遊休閒企業，澳娛綜合過去十年持續透過全國兩會精神分享會、江西井岡山愛國主義教育培訓課程，以及「我和我的祖國灣區行」等項目，深化團隊成員對國家發展的認識，厚植家國情懷，鼓勵團隊把握國家及澳門發展機遇。

item.title: NBA關懷行動×金沙關懷籃球公益周啟動 藉體育凝聚社區啟迪青年
item.description:
>
NBA關懷行動×金沙關懷籃球公益周啟動，將籃球盛事熱力從賽場延伸至社區。 適逢NBA中國賽2026落戶澳門，由金沙中國聯手NBA關懷行動(NBA Cares)合辦的「NBA關懷行動×金沙關懷籃球公益周2026」今日(8日)於澳門威尼斯人綜藝館舉行啟動日，標誌這為期五天(7至11日)的大型體育公益系列活動全面展開。現場匯集約500位嘉賓，包括達拉斯獨行俠、侯斯頓火箭兩支參戰NBA中國賽球隊的現役球員、NBA管理層、傳奇球星、金沙集團管理團隊、澳門學界籃球健兒以及中外傳媒，將世界級籃球盛事的熱力從競技賽場延伸至社區當中。 啟動日現場星光熠熠，NBA傳奇球星姚明、馬利安(Shawn Marion)親臨支持；獨行俠與火箭隊現役球員化身青年導師，與澳門學界比賽冠軍隊鏡平學校女子D組、鮑思高高華小學男子D組的學生互動切磋，傳授實戰籃球技巧。球員、澳門學生連同金沙關懷大使一同動手製作愛心禮包，把善意送給社區群眾，落實公益關懷理念。 拉斯維加斯金沙集團董事會主席兼行政總裁、達拉斯獨行俠隊班主Patrick Dumont在活動上表示，集團扎根澳門二十餘載，期望藉賽事延伸效應，發揮體育凝聚社區、啟迪青年的力量，持續助力澳門「旅遊+」戰略與和諧社區建設。 本次公益周規模較往年進一步升級，參與群體擴展至整個粵港澳大灣區。系列活動早在昨日(7日)已打響頭炮，首場「青少年籃球日」於澳門東亞運動會體育館舉行，來自澳門8間學校共150名11至14歲青少年球員，連同50名香港及大灣區內地城市青年參與訓練及比賽。NBA兩屆總冠軍、籃球名人堂成員雷阿倫(Ray Allen)聯同NBA教練、中國籃球名將丁彥雨航、中國女籃張子宇組成明星導師陣容，帶領三地青年開展步伐、運球、攻防專業訓練；青年球員跨地域混合編隊，展開男、女子友誼交流賽，同步舉辦個人技巧挑戰賽，賽後頒獎嘉許表現出色的小選手，透過實戰切磋拉近粵港澳青少年距離，搭建友誼橋樑。 「青少年籃球日」當日亦設置「女生主場」座談會，邀請NBA助理副總裁Dawn Smyth、達拉斯獨行俠隊首席傳播官Gina Miller、侯斯頓火箭隊總裁Gretchen Sheirr以及金沙中國高級副總裁兼首席度假村營銷總裁尤穎擔任嘉賓，分享女性成長與職場經歷，鼓勵年輕一代建立自信、勇於追尋目標。 金沙中國行政副主席王英偉感謝澳門政府及社會各界鼎力支持，指這已是集團連續第二年借NBA中國賽平台把體育正能量帶入社區。集團今年將活動輻射到大灣區，加強區域青年連結，並透過專題座談啟迪新一代。未來金沙中國會繼續配合澳門政府經濟適度多元發展方向，推動體育與旅遊深度融合，擦亮澳門「體育之城」的品牌名片。 據介紹，公益周會持續至本月11日，繼啟動日後，明日(9日)將走進粵華中學開展「校園日」，接續透過籃球運動，把體育精神與公益溫暖傳遞給更多大灣區青少年。

item.title: 9月賭收創今年新低反映客多消費降新常態 專家指業界需時適應
item.description: https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/10月7日.mp4 根據澳門博監局最新公佈數據顯示，澳門今年9月份博彩毛收入為180.63億元(澳門元、下同)，按月下跌約17.49%，創下今年以來單月賭收最低紀錄。澳門大學工商管理學院綜合度假村及旅遊管理學系教授、澳門大學博彩研究所所長馮家超分析指，這是因新政策衍生出的全新旅遊與消費現象，業界與學術界需要時間適應與觀察。惟他對賭收全年達標的機會依然樂觀。澳門負責任博彩協會會長宋偉傑則認為，旅客赴澳的旅遊模式與博彩收益之間的差距正顯著擴大。 針對9月澳門賭收創今年新低但入境旅客未見大減的現象，馮家超進一步剖析，這與近期實施的多項全新入境簽證政策(如珠海「一周一行」、橫琴團客多次往返等便利措施)息息相關。 他指這些新政策導致入境旅客數量增加，但實質上是「同一個人頻繁往返」。旅客赴澳旅遊本有固定預算，雖然因簽註便利令入境次數增加，但總消費預算並未成比例放大。 與此同時，澳門統計暨普查局數據亦顯示，2026年上半年留宿旅客錄約805萬人次，增幅僅0.2%；而不過夜的旅客約1,289萬人次，大幅增長15.3%，許多旅客選擇即日往返原居地或在鄰近地區過夜，因此拉低了人均博彩與整體過夜消費表現。馮家超強調，這並非單純的短期經濟周期波動，而是因新政策衍生出的全新旅遊與消費現象，業界與學術界需要時間去適應與觀察。 至於全年賭收表現，馮家超預測今年全年澳門博彩毛收入可望在2,500億至2,600億元之間，接近年初的預期目標，第四季每月平均賭收若維持約210億至220億元左右，全年達標機會依然樂觀。針對非博彩元素與國際客源的貢獻，他認為大方向正確，有助分散下行風險，但目前國際客源的實際數據因統計限制而低於真實情況，短期內要全面填補高端客群下降的缺口仍具挑戰。 展望未來新常態，馮家超建議除了深化大灣區各城市的市場滲透、配合旅客偏好推動高品質非博彩活動(如演唱會、拳擊賽事等)外，更應長遠增加酒店房間供應與過夜承載能力，才能有效延長旅客逗留時間，進一步帶動全方位的餐飲與博彩消費增長。 澳門負責任博彩協會會長宋偉傑受訪時表示，目前旅客赴澳的旅遊模式與博彩收益之間的差距正顯著擴大。以往澳門博彩業以貴賓廳(VIP)為主力，人均博彩消費基數較大；隨着新博彩法實施及貴賓廳業務進行調整，VIP客群大幅減少，高額投注數字隨之下降。當前赴澳旅客已轉向以「體驗式消費」為主，博彩消費相應減少，這正是導致「客量多、人均博彩消費降」的主因。 宋偉傑認為，中場旅客的消費雖然較為平均、單筆金額不如過往貴賓廳龐大，但能避免賭收出現「大上大落」的極端波動。從數據來看，轉型至中場為主後，澳門博彩收益已漸趨穩定，行業整體風險相對降低，有利於朝向健康、多元與可持續的方向發展。

item.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Celebrates Tip-Off Star-Studded Event Promotes GBA Youth Sports Exchange
item.description:
>
Sands Launches Basketball Charity Week: Star-Studded Event Promotes Greater Bay Area Youth Sports Exchange Ahead of The NBA China Games 2026, Sands China and NBA Cares held the Tip-Off Day as part of the “NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026” today (Oct, 8) at The Venetian Arena. This marks the full rollout of the five-day large-scale sports and charity series running from October 7 to 11. Around 400 guests gathered at the venue, including current players from the Dallas Mavericks and the Houston Rockets—the two teams competing in the NBA China Games—alongside NBA executives, NBA legends, executives and team members from Las Vegas Sands and Sands China, members of local school basketball teams, and local and international media. The event successfully extended the excitement of a world-class basketball spectacle from the competitive arena directly into the local community. The Tip-Off event, featuring special appearances by NBA legends Yao Ming and Shawn Marion. Current players from the Mavericks and Rockets stepped into the roles of youth mentors, interacting and sharing hands-on basketball skills with Macao’s school competition championship teams—the Division D girls’ team from Keang Peng School and the Division D boys’ team from Colégio Dom Bosco (Yuet Wah). Alongside Sands Cares Ambassadors, the players and local students worked together to assemble Goodie bags packing to be distributed to community members, bringing the ethos of charity and community care to life. Patrick Dumont, chairman of the board and chief executive officer of Las Vegas Sands Corp., and chairman of the board and non-executive director of Sands China Ltd., and governor of the Dallas Mavericks, stated at the event that the group has deep roots in Macao for over two decades. He hopes to leverage the extended impact of the tournament to harness the power of sports in uniting communities and inspiring youth, continuously supporting Macao’s “Tourism+” strategy and the building of a harmonious community. Community Impact Week has scaled up significantly compared to previous editions, expanding its participant demographic across the entire Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA). The series kicked off early on October 7 with the opening “Youth Basketball Day” held at the Macao East Asian Games Dome. A total of 150 young players aged 11 to 14 from eight Macao schools, alongside 50 youth participants from Hong Kong and mainland cities in the GBA, took part in training sessions and matches. A star-studded coaching lineup featuring two-time NBA champion and Hall of Famer Ray Allen, NBA coaches, Chinese basketball star Ding Yanyuhang, and Chinese women’s basketball player Zhang Ziyu led the youth from the three regions through professional training on footwork, dribbling, and offense-defense strategies. Young players were mixed into cross-regional teams for friendly youth exhibition matches and an individual skills challenge. Awards were presented after the matches to commend outstanding young athletes, narrowing the distance between youth in Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao through practical competition and building bridges of friendship. The “Youth Day” also featured a ” Her Time To Play ” panel discussion, inviting Dawn Smyth, NBA Vice President, International Basketball Operations; Gina Miller, Chief Communications Officer of the Dallas Mavericks; Gretchen Sheirr, President of the Houston Rockets; and Winnie Yu, Senior Vice President and Chief Resort Marketing Officer of Sands China Ltd., as guest speakers. They shared their personal growth and professional journeys, encouraging the younger generation to build self-confidence and bravely pursue their goals. Dr. Wilfred Wong, Executive Vice Chairman of Sands China Ltd., expressed gratitude to the Macao SAR Government and all sectors of society for their staunch support. This marks the second consecutive year that the group has leveraged the NBA China Games platform to bring positive sports energy into the community. By expanding the event’s reach to the GBA this year, the initiative strengthens regional youth connections and inspires the next generation through special thematic seminars. Moving forward, Sands China will continue to align with the SAR Government’s direction of moderate economic diversification, promoting the deep integration of sports and tourism to polish Macao’s name card as a “City of Sports.” According to organizers, the community impact week will run through October 11. Following the launch day, tomorrow (October 9) will feature the ” School Day ” at Yuet Wah College , continuing to pass on the spirit of sportsmanship and charitable warmth to even more youths across the GBA through basketball.

item.title: Macau’s September Gross Gaming Revenue Drops by 17.49%
item.description:
https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/10月7日.mp4 Macau’s gross gaming revenue (GGR) for September stood at MOP 18.063 billion, representing a month-on-month decrease of approximately 17.49% and hitting the lowest monthly record for the year, according to the latest data released by the Gaming Inspection and Coordination Bureau (DICJ),
Davis Fong, Director of Institute for the Study of Commercial Gaming at the University of Macau, analyzed that this phenomenon stems from new tourism and consumption trends generated by new policies, requiring time for both the industry and academia to observe and adapt. Nevertheless, he remains optimistic about achieving the full-year GGR target. Meanwhile, Billy Song, President of Macau Responsible Gaming Association, noted that the gap between visitors’ travel patterns and gaming revenues is widening significantly.
Policy Dividends and Facilitated Custom Clearance: Triggering the New Normal of “Frequent Multiple Entries by the Same Individuals”
Addressing the paradox of September’s record-low GGR alongside resilient inbound visitor numbers, Davis Fong, Associate Professor in Integrated Resort and Tourism Management and Director of Institute for the Study of Commercial Gaming at the University of Macau, explained that this is closely tied to recently implemented entry visa policies (such as Zhuhai’s “one trip per week” and multiple-entry measures for Hengqin tour groups).
He pointed out that these new policies have increased visitor arrival counts, but in reality, they reflect “the same individuals traveling back and forth frequently.” Visitors come to Macau with fixed travel budgets; although visa convenience increases their frequency of entry, their total spending budget does not scale up proportionally.
Meanwhile, data from the Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) showed that in the first half of 2026, overnight visitors reached approximately 8.05 million, a marginal increase of 0.2%, whereas same-day (non-overnight) visitors surged by 15.3% to about 12.89 million. Many visitors chose to return home the same day or stay in neighboring regions, pulling down per capita gaming and overall overnight spending performance. Fong emphasized that this is not merely a short-term economic cycle fluctuation, but rather a brand-new tourism and consumption phenomenon spawned by new policies, which the industry and academia need time to observe and adapt to.
Optimistic Full-Year GGR Outlook: Experts Offer Strategies to Deepen Non-Gaming Transformation and Enhance Carrying Capacity
Regarding full-year gaming revenue performance, Fong projected that total GGR for the year is expected to land between MOP 250 billion and MOP 260 billion, close to the initial target set at the beginning of the year. If the average monthly GGR for the fourth quarter (October to December) maintains around MOP 21 billion to MOP 22 billion, the chance of hitting the full-year target remains optimistic. Regarding the contribution of non-gaming elements and international source markets, he believes the general direction is correct and helps mitigate downside risks. However, due to statistical limitations, current actual data for international visitors underrepresents reality, making it challenging in the short term to fully bridge the gap left by the decline in high-end clientele.
Looking ahead to the new normal, Fong suggested that aside from deepening market penetration across Greater Bay Area cities and promoting high-quality non-gaming activities tailored to traveler preferences (such as concerts and boxing matches), Macau should also expand hotel room supply and overnight carrying capacity in the long run. This is essential to effectively extend visitors’ length of stay and further drive comprehensive growth in dining and gaming consumption.
Shift Toward “Experiential Consumption” Leads to Decline in Gaming Figures
In an interview, Billy Song, President of Macau Responsible Gaming Association, stated that the gap between current visitor travel patterns and gaming revenue is widening significantly. Historically, Macau’s gaming industry was anchored by VIP rooms, boasting a higher baseline of per capita gaming spend. With the implementation of the new Gaming Law and subsequent adjustments to VIP operations, the VIP clientele has dropped significantly, leading to a decline in high-rolling figures. Today’s visitors to Macau have shifted toward experiential consumption, resulting in a corresponding decrease in gaming spend, which is the primary reason behind the phenomenon of high visitor volume accompanied by lower per capita gaming expenditure.
Song believes that although mass-market visitors have more moderate spending patterns with single-transaction amounts lower than past VIP levels, this stability helps prevent extreme fluctuations in GGR. Judging by the data, following the transition to a mass-market-led model, Macau’s gaming revenue has gradually stabilized, lowering overall industry risk and favoring a healthy, diversified, and sustainable direction of development.
